name.en: Trans-Canada Highway 1 in Prince Edward Island
name.zh: 爱德华王子岛省横加公路 1 号

tagline.en: A spur that arrives over the longest bridge across ice-covered water
tagline.zh: 一条支线，经由跨越结冰水域的世界最长桥梁抵达

start.en: Borden-Carleton, at the island end of the Confederation Bridge from New Brunswick
start.zh: 博登－卡尔顿，自新不伦瑞克而来的联邦大桥在岛上的落点

end.en: The Wood Islands ferry terminal, for the crossing to Caribou, Nova Scotia
end.zh: 木岛渡轮码头，由此渡往新斯科舍的卡里布

en: Prince Edward Island's Route 1 is a spur rather than part of the main line, and it exists because the Trans-Canada was defined to reach provincial capitals. It runs from the bridge at Borden-Carleton through Charlottetown to the ferry at Wood Islands, so both of the island's fixed links to the mainland are on the designated route.
At 71 miles it is the shortest provincial share of the Trans-Canada, and along with Newfoundland it is one of only two provinces to carry the designation on a single number. Ontario uses eleven.

The approach from New Brunswick is the most remarkable structure on the whole highway. The Confederation Bridge is 12.9 kilometres of post-tensioned concrete on 250-metre spans, and it is the longest bridge in the world crossing water that freezes.
zh: 爱德华王子岛的 1 号公路是一条支线而非主线，其存在是因为横加公路的定义要求通达各省省会。它自博登－卡尔顿的大桥起，经夏洛特敦，至木岛的渡轮码头，使该岛通往大陆的两处固定连接都落在指定路线上。
全长 71 英里，是横加公路各省路段中最短的一段；它与纽芬兰同为仅有的两个只用单一编号承载指定路线的省份。安大略用了十一个。
自新不伦瑞克方向的接入段，是全线最引人注目的构筑物。联邦大桥全长 12.9 公里，为后张预应力混凝土结构，主跨 250 米，是世界上跨越结冰水域最长的桥梁。

en: The island signed its Trans-Canada agreement on 25 April 1950 along with six other provinces. For its first forty-seven years the designated route reached the mainland only by boat.

A fixed link had been argued about since Confederation. The question was put to islanders in a plebiscite on 18 January 1988 and carried with 59.4 per cent in favour — a majority, but not an overwhelming one, and the campaign against it turned on what a bridge would do to the ferry jobs and to the island's separateness.

The bridge opened on 31 May 1997, built and operated by Strait Crossing Bridge Limited at a cost of about $840 million. The main bridge spans eleven kilometres of the Northumberland Strait, with access viaducts making up the rest and a navigation channel cleared to 49 metres.
zh: 该岛于 1950 年 4 月 25 日与另外六省同日签署横加公路协议。此后的四十七年里，这条指定路线只能靠船抵达大陆。
关于固定连接的争论自联邦成立之初就未停过。1988 年 1 月 18 日，岛民以公投作答，59.4% 赞成通过——是多数，但算不上压倒性；反对一方的理由，在于一座桥会如何影响渡轮从业者的生计，以及这座岛的独立性。
大桥于 1997 年 5 月 31 日通车，由海峡桥梁有限公司建设并运营，造价约 8.4 亿加元。主桥跨越诺森伯兰海峡十一公里，其余由引桥构成，通航孔净空 49 米。

label.zh: 爱德华王子岛境内长度

value.en: 71 miles (114 km) — the shortest provincial share of the main route
value.zh: 71 英里（114 公里），为主线各省路段中最短的一段

figures.source: Canada Year Book 1967, p. 805, Dominion Bureau of Statistics

value.en: 12.9 km, opened 31 May 1997, cost about $840 million; 250 m main spans and 49 m navigation clearance; the longest bridge in the world over ice-covered water
value.zh: 全长 12.9 公里，1997 年 5 月 31 日通车，造价约 8.4 亿加元；主跨 250 米，通航净空 49 米；为世界上跨越结冰水域最长的桥梁

figures.source: Confederation Bridge operator, confederationbridge.com; cost from The Canadian Encyclopedia

timeline.en: Prince Edward Island signs its Trans-Canada Highway agreement on 25 April.
timeline.zh: 4 月 25 日，爱德华王子岛签署横加公路协议。

timeline.en: Islanders vote 59.4 per cent in favour of a fixed link to the mainland on 18 January.
timeline.zh: 1 月 18 日，岛民以 59.4% 的赞成率通过修建通往大陆的固定连接。

timeline.en: The Confederation Bridge opens on 31 May, putting the island's Trans-Canada spur on a road connection for the first time.
timeline.zh: 5 月 31 日，联邦大桥通车，该岛的横加公路支线首次有了陆路连接。
